english: The list included most of the things Hugh loves: butter, potatoes, rice, beer, milk, chocolate, and sweets.
text: 先总说 The list included most of the things Hugh loves，再用冒号逐项列出来，是先给整体印象再补细节的写法。想列举具体内容时，先概括“里面有什么类别”，再列具体项会更有条理。
